conclusions.root_cause_mechanism: Server-side constrained decoding think prelude bound (_THINK_PRELUDE_DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS=4000) causes llguidance parser rejection when complex prompts induce deep reasoning exceeding 4000 characters, leading to unhandled RuntimeError and HTTP 500.
verified_remediations: Setting MTPLX_THINK_PRELUDE_MAX_CHARS=0 (unbounded reasoning prelude) in server environment
Setting MTPLX_THINK_PRELUDE_MAX_CHARS=16000 (proportionately expanded reasoning budget) in server environment
Prompt engineering / system contract enforcement to keep reasoning under 4000 characters if server cannot be reconfigured
